import React from "react"; import { Link } from "react-router-dom"; import { AccountBalanceWalletOutlined, AssessmentOutlined, ReceiptLongOutlined, ShowChartOutlined, TravelExploreOutlined, } from "@mui/icons-material"; import "./Apps.css"; const appLinks = [ { title: "Portfolio", description: "Review your holdings, market value, and portfolio P&L.", to: "/holdings", icon: AssessmentOutlined, action: "View holdings", }, { title: "Positions", description: "Track your open demo intraday positions.", to: "/positions", icon: ShowChartOutlined, action: "View positions", }, { title: "Orders", description: "See your saved buy and sell order history.", to: "/orders", icon: ReceiptLongOutlined, action: "View orders", }, { title: "Funds", description: "Manage your virtual balance and review transactions.", to: "/funds", icon: AccountBalanceWalletOutlined, action: "Manage funds", }, ]; const Apps = () => (

Apps & shortcuts

Quick access to your demo trading workspace.

{appLinks.map(({ title, description, to, icon: Icon, action }) => (

{title}

{description}

{action} →
))}
